Proof in the paper: The XRD pattern of Ni-BDC corresponds well to the simulated Ni-BDC, indicating that the two-dimensional Ni-BDC is well crystallized. The main diffraction peaks of the three catalysts appeared at about 8.9° and were identified to the characteristic (200) facet. The TEM and HAADF-STEM images show a clear two-dimensional structure for all three catalysts.
